Key facts recorded before implementation:

- F-414 measured the default-dropping loss: z3 keeps 0.03 % of sites, z10
  5.7 %, z12 25.6 %; tippecanoe base-zoom = max-zoom with drop rate 2.5 and
  no retention flags. The fix is `-r1` + per-feature
  `"tippecanoe": {"minzoom","maxzoom","layer"}` members + a forbidden-flags
  guard + fail-loud oversize — and the pure-Python renderer must honour the
  same ranges and dedupe byte-identical features only (the `_DEDUP_CELL`
  coalescing of distinct same-cell entities is the second silent loss).
- v2 archive shape: `cells` (point at the transformed mean position, H3
  res 3/4/5/6 for z0–4/z5–6/z7–8/z9; props `h3`/`n`/`ns`) + `sites`
  (`rk`+`tr`; tier 0 from z10, tier 1 from z11, tier 2 from z12 as its H3
  polygon, tier 3 never). Counts stay per compartment — a cross-compartment
  count archive is a licence-mixed derived database (ADR-106 §4) and is
  never emitted; the browser sums (MAP-03 consumes).
- Minimal property set this row ships: `h3`,`n`,`ns` on cells; `rk` =
  `record_key(compartment, entity_type, entity_id)` and `tr` on sites. The
  rest of the §3.3 vocabulary is MAP-01b's (row 440) — recorded seam.
- `web/tiles/index.json` carries per archive: `{compartment, path, sha256,
  licence, attribution, bounds, minzoom, maxzoom, counts{points,
  cells_by_band}, renderer, renderer_version, contract: "sig.map-tiles/2"}`
  plus a `source` key naming the `<comp>/<table>.geojson` the archive was
  verified against (additive, truthful — the verifier needs it; the
  jurisdiction bundle's input is `devices.geojson`, not `sites.geojson`).
- Content-hash names: `<comp>-sites.<sha8>.pmtiles` where `sha8` = leading
  8 hex of the archive sha256 — so nginx can serve `immutable` (D12). Every
  `*-sites.pmtiles` reader (data.ts, export-tiles.mjs, publish.py
  `assert_site_matches_partition`, national fixture, e2e/unit tests) widens
  to the hashed name.
- Tier-2 display polygon: the published tier-2 transform is the declared
  ~1 km bin (`policy/data/sensitivity.toml` grid_bin 1000 m); the contract
  renders the H3 cell at the contract's tier-2 display resolution (res 8,
  ≈ 0.74 km² — closest H3 band to the declared bin) around the already
  tier-reduced point. Recorded in ADR-156.
- `NATIONAL_ZOOM_MAX` 6 → 9 (the cells/points band boundary);
  `MIN_POINT_ZOOM_BY_TIER` is pinned to the contract values {10, 11, 12,
  never} so the seam constants cannot drift from the emitted ranges — the
  island's own rendering change stays MAP-03's (recorded seam; the helpers
  remain un-called here).
- `sig-exports tiles verify --in <dir>` (render form keeps `--in/--out`
  working) writes `reports/tiles_verify.json` inside the candidate dir and
  exits nonzero on any failed check. Its six checks are K1 §9.2 verbatim:
  conservation, renderer parity, precision/tier/properties, size
  (≤ 500 KiB / warn 200 KiB), metadata equality vs `index.json`, and the
  CI/nightly wiring (check 6 lives in the workflows, not the tool).
- Back-compat: `sig-exports tiles --in F --out O` still renders a
  single-layer archive; old unhashed archives still match the widened
  readers. Old published archives are byte-stable (never rewritten).

## Phase 2 — implementation outcome

- **Renderer (`exports/src/exports/tiles.py`).** Every emitted feature
  carries a `tippecanoe` member `{layer, minzoom, maxzoom}`; the two-layer
  emit produces `cells` (H3 res 3/4/5/6 over z0–4/5–6/7–8/9) and `sites`
  (tier 0 z10, tier 1 z11, tier 2 z12 as its res-8 H3 polygon, tier 3
  never). tippecanoe argv carries `-r1`; the flag guard rejects
  `--drop-*`/`--coalesce*`/`--cluster-distance`/`--maximum-tile-bytes`/
  `--base-zoom`; a stored tile over 500 KiB raises
  `TileSizeLimitExceeded` (warn at 200 KiB). The pure-Python PMTiles/MVT
  path honours the same ranges, encodes polygons, and dedupes only
  byte-identical features.
- **Manifest/export (`manifest.py`, `spine_export.py`, `cli.py`,
  `ops/publish.py`, `ops/web/nginx.conf`).** `web/tiles/index.json`
  (`sig.map-tiles/2`) lists each archive's compartment, content-hashed
  path `<comp>-sites.<sha8>.pmtiles`, sha256, licence, attribution,
  bounds, zooms, counts, renderer(+version), contract and source
  GeoJSON; archives + index register in the export manifests (missing
  manifest stays fail-closed; an honestly empty index is legal). nginx
  serves hashed `/tiles/*.<sha8>.pmtiles` `immutable`, mutable paths
  revalidate.
- **Verifier (`exports/src/exports/tile_verify.py`).**
  `sig-exports tiles verify --in <export-dir>` writes
  `reports/tiles_verify.json`; five in-tool checks per archive
  (conservation over Σ`n` and `rk` sets, renderer parity vs a fresh
  pure-Python replay — honestly `vacuous` only when the shipped archive
  was itself pure-Python, precision/tier/property vocabulary, size,
  archive-vs-index-vs-manifest metadata) plus the CI-wiring check that
  lives in the workflows. Verified locally end-to-end on the 50k fixture
  rendered by **real tippecanoe 2.79.0** (built from the ops/Dockerfile
  pin via `make check-tile-verify`): `verdict: pass`, 3 archives,
  parity `vacuous: false`, 0 diffs.
- **Web (`map.ts`, `map-tiles.ts`, `data.ts`, `MapIsland.tsx`,
  `export-tiles.mjs`).** `NATIONAL_ZOOM_MAX = 9`; one PMTiles source per
  compartment (no licence-mixed archive); `cells` national layer, `sites`
  circle + tier-2 fill; the island sums visible `cells` counts across
  active compartments in memory; per-source attribution; hashed paths
  resolve through `index.json`; no-JS table + fixture-mode inline points
  preserved.
- **CI/nightly (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `scripts/ci/*`, `Makefile`,
  `.gitignore`).** Pinned tippecanoe resolved from `ops/Dockerfile`,
  cached (`actions/cache` keyed on the pin), built via
  `build_tippecanoe.sh` (portable: `sha256sum`/`shasum`, `nproc`/`getconf`,
  no `install -D`; cache-hit no-op is pipefail-safe); the web job runs
  `tile_verify_leg.sh fixture|verify` over the deterministic 50k fixture;
  nightly runs `national|verify` at real scale with `continue-on-error` +
  report wiring like the other legs. `make check-tile-verify` mirrors the
  leg for `ci-local` parity (`test_ci_workflows` enforces it).
- **Docs.** ADR-156 written (Proposed, agent-drafted, labelled;
  `## Revisit trigger` present; Appendix F row added via spec_src +
  regenerated canonical spec; ADR_TRIGGERS.csv row home BL-077; BACKLOG
  BL-077 sources now own ADR-156). CHANGELOG entry lands under Added.
